name: sapphire
description: Sapphire OS — multi-agent dispatch, token governance, verification, health monitoring, forecasting, and cyber research

tools.name: sapphire_dispatch
tools.description: Route a development task to the optimal inference tier (T0=Nemotron free, T1=Kimi subscription, T3=Claude expensive). Classifies task complexity via Nemotron, checks token budget, executes on cheapest capable tier.

tools.name: sapphire_verify
tools.description: Run lint (ruff) and tests (pytest) on a repo. Returns pass/fail status and whether it's safe to commit. Use after making code changes.

tools.name: sapphire_budget
tools.description: Show token usage per inference tier for today. Shows T0 (Nemotron/free), T1 (Kimi), T3 (Claude) with budget bars and call counts.

tools.name: sapphire_state
tools.description: Read/write persistent factory state. Tracks known issues, fix attempts, backoff timers. Prevents re-attempting failed fixes.

tools.name: sapphire_status
tools.description: Query Sapphire mesh status — Tailscale devices, Ollama models on GPU and local.

tools.name: sapphire_notify
tools.description: Send a Telegram notification via NemotronRariBot. Priority: p0=urgent, p1=normal, p2=low.

tools.name: sapphire_health_check
tools.description: Run Sapphire's unified health check across services, repos, data freshness, and inference endpoints. Supports brief and full profiles.

tools.name: sapphire_market
tools.description: Unified market data — equity quotes, crypto OHLCV, FRED macro, news via OpenBB (32 providers) + TradingView live chart data, Pine Script CI. Actions: quote, crypto, historical, fred, news, snapshot, tv_quote, tv_ohlcv, tv_levels, tv_strategy, pine_ci.

tools.name: sapphire_predict_kronos
tools.description: Kronos foundation-model forecasting for candles and market direction. Actions: predict, batch, status. Successful predict/batch calls also refresh `data/intelligence/YYYY-MM-DD/predictions.json`.

tools.name: sapphire_threat_intel
tools.description: Threat intelligence via cyber-threat-bot. Actions: latest, brief, offers, scan. Persists markdown outputs under `data/threat_intel/` and may emit threat.detected events.

tools.name: sapphire_lumo_research
tools.description: Security-focused research through the local Proton Lumo bridge. Actions: ask, security_brief, status. Redacts common secret patterns before sending prompts.

tools.name: sapphire_starred_repos
tools.description: GitHub starred-repo sync and synergy analysis. Actions: sync, analyze, report, trending. Persists outputs under `data/starred_repos/`.

tools.name: sapphire_macro_data
tools.description: FRED macro-economic indicators: GDP, CPI, unemployment, rates, housing. Actions: dashboard, rates, housing, series. Feeds trading_brain macro sentiment. Graceful fallback if FRED API key missing.

tools.name: sapphire_lead_engine
tools.description: AI-powered outbound lead generation. Analyze websites to extract ICP, discover matching businesses from Regional Intel data, generate personalized outreach. Actions: analyze, discover, outreach, pipeline.

tools.name: sapphire_trading_brain
tools.description: Unified trading decision engine combining TA, ensemble signals, Kronos, macro, and paper track record. Produces GO/LEAN/WAIT decisions with confidence. Actions: decide, dashboard. Decisions logged for accuracy tracking.
